why: Neither must_catch item is handled in the verifier brief. Item 1: Check 4 reads the live page with `curl ... https://o.github.io/greet-cli/`. It mentions the merge dependency and pages.yml only in a note. It never checks at the PR head that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main, and it says "Do not mark it PASS based on docs/index.md alone." Item 2: Check 2 compares the output only to hand-written strings (`"Hello, Ada!"`, `"Hello, Ada Lovelace!"`). It asserts "These are the outputs the program produced before the change" but never runs the base commit's bin/greet.js to compare.
